title: Fulgurites in Giza iron veins as evidence of high-voltage current

tellings.quote: In these iron ore veins, we have samples that contain fulgurites, which is evidence of high-voltage electric current distribution through these iron veins.

plain: Samples from iron ore veins at the Giza Plateau in Egypt contain fulgurites, glassy traces left when a powerful electric current melts rock, and these show that high-voltage current once ran through the veins. A researcher named Jeffrey Drum makes this claim to Michels without naming a source. If he is right, it would point to an energy grid beneath the pyramids.
